# Themes, motion and platform feels

Every Ballmac item reads the standard shadcn CSS variables, so it follows your theme. Install a ready-made theme, or build one at https://ui.ballmac.com/themes and install the exact result from its link.

## Themes (12)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/theme-<name>`. Each one also sets how the product moves.

- **graphite**: Quiet greys, ink buttons. Suits: Dashboards and admin tools; Products that should look neutral and let content lead. Motion: snappy.
- **ocean**: Clear blue, friendly corners. Suits: SaaS and fintech products; Anything that should feel trustworthy. Motion: native.
- **indigo**: Deep blue-violet, rounder. Suits: Developer tools and AI products; Marketing sites that want a distinct colour. Motion: native.
- **violet**: Rich purple, very round. Suits: Creative tools and communities; Consumer apps. Motion: playful.
- **rose**: Warm pink-red, soft. Suits: Lifestyle, health and community products; Shops with a friendly voice. Motion: native.
- **ember**: Burnt orange, crisp. Suits: Developer platforms and media; Calls to action that must stand out. Motion: playful.
- **amber**: Ink buttons, golden accents. Suits: Editorial and docs sites; Brands that want warmth without a coloured button. Motion: native.
- **forest**: Deep green, grounded. Suits: Sustainability, finance and wellness; Products that should feel calm and established. Motion: calm.
- **teal**: Fresh blue-green, round. Suits: Health, data and productivity apps; Dashboards that want a friendly tone. Motion: native.
- **sand**: Warm paper, terracotta. Suits: Portfolios, publications and studios; Shops with a crafted feel. Motion: calm.
- **mono**: Pure black and white, square. Suits: Brutalist and technical products; Teams that need maximum contrast. Motion: snappy.
- **midnight**: Electric sky blue, strong edges. Suits: Developer and gaming products; Apps used mostly in dark mode. Motion: calm.

## Motion (5)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/motion-<name>`. Motion is theme data (speed, bounce, travel, hover, stagger); the reduced-motion fallback is built in.

- **native**: Quick, quiet, a hint of spring
- **calm**: Slower, no overshoot, small moves
- **snappy**: Fast, tight, almost instant
- **playful**: Bouncy, bigger moves, eager hover
- **still**: Fades only, for everyone

## Platform feels (4)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/feel-<name>`. A feel changes how every control handles (sizes, radii, focus, press).

- **web**: Neutral, as it is today
- **macos**: Compact, soft shadows, frosted menus
- **ios**: Big targets, rounded, dims on press
- **windows**: Square-ish, bordered, crisp 2 px focus
